title: Plus Member Lens Discount at Northgate Optical
content:
Members whose membership on the eyewear job is a Plus tier on the order date receive a lens discount at Northgate Optical. The discount applies to two charge components only: the base lenses and the lens material upgrade. It is never combined with vision plan billing on the same job.

| Lens design | Plus lens discount | Components discounted | Combinable with vision plan billing |
|---|---|---|---|
| Northgate Single Vision Lenses | 10 percent | base lenses, material upgrade | no |
| Northgate Lined Bifocal Lenses | 10 percent | base lenses, material upgrade | no |
| Northgate Lined Trifocal Lenses | 10 percent | base lenses, material upgrade | no |
| Northgate Standard Progressive Lenses | 15 percent | base lenses, material upgrade | no |
| Northgate Premium Progressive Lenses | 15 percent | base lenses, material upgrade | no |
| Northgate Digital Freeform Progressive Lenses | 15 percent | base lenses, material upgrade | no |

The frame, anti-reflective coating, light-adaptive option and blue-light filtering option are not discounted on any design.

### Questions this schedule answers

**Which percentage applies to a progressive design?** 15 percent on Northgate Standard, Premium and Digital Freeform Progressive Lenses; 10 percent on the single vision, bifocal and trifocal designs.

**Does the discount reach an option ordered on the job?** No. Only the base lenses and the material upgrade are discounted.

**Can a member use both a vision plan and the Plus discount on one job?** No. On every design the Plus discount is not combinable with vision plan billing.
